messages.subject: Lavaan AIC BIC not calculated.
parts:
I've succesfully ran a CFA in Lavaan, however the AIC and BIC are not calculated (=na). Why is that?
 
fit_original_PML <- cfa(CFA_model_P_original, data=P_items_original, ordered=names(P_items_original), estimator="PML")

fitMeasures_original_PML <- fitMeasures(fit_original_PML, fit.measures = c("cfi","tli","rmsea","srmr","aic","bic"))

fitMeasures_original_PML

Guido

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Lavaan AIC BIC not calculated.
parts:
On 10/8/20 12:10 PM, Guido wrote:
> I've succesfully ran a CFA in Lavaan, however the AIC and BIC are not
> calculated (=na). Why is that?
> fit_original_PML <- cfa(CFA_model_P_original, data=P_items_original,
> ordered=names(P_items_original), estimator="PML")

Because you use estimator = "PML". In that case, the usual AIC/BIC does
not exist, but a special version can be obtained by

lavaan:::ctr_pml_aic_bic(fit_original_PML)

See section 5.6 in the PML tutorial:

https://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/pml/PL_Tutorial.pdf

Yves.
